title: Graphiti doc led improvements - Upgrade Searching capabilities to match Graphiti guidance
description:
References
- Graph namespacing: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/core-concepts/graph-namespacing
- Communities: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/core-concepts/communities
- Searching: https://help.getzep.com/graphiti/working-with-data/searching
- SDK Reference: https://help.getzep.com/v3/sdk-reference

Problem:
- We wrap Graphiti.search but only expose a narrow interface and do significant post-filtering.
- We do not expose label/property filters, center-node pivots beyond a few flows, or ranked node search results beyond an area-limited fulltext query.

What Graphiti provides
- Hybrid search over nodes/edges with:
  - free-text + vector + graph proximity ranking,
  - center_node_uuid to bias results around a pivot,
  - group_ids to constrain namespace,
  - control over number of results and, in some setups, label filters.

features.title: General search API
features.description:
Add GET /search and POST /areas/{area_name}/search with parameters:
  - query: str
  - top_k: int
  - center_node_uuid: optional
  - group_ids: optional list
  - include_labels: optional list of labels to prioritize or filter
  - edge_types: optional list (e.g., CALLS, DEPENDS_ON_CLASS) for post-filtering
Return:
  - edges: Graphiti result edges (with scores), optionally filtered by edge_types and constrained to nodes in the area.
  - nodes: top node hits using db.index.fulltext.queryNodes limited to the given labels and area scope.

features.title: Class/Method-centric semantic search
features.description:
Add endpoints:
  - GET /code-projects/{area}/search/classes?query=...
  - GET /code-projects/{area}/search/methods?query=...
Internally apply include_labels filters to restrict to Entity:Class or Entity:Method nodes and return top matches with their defining files and dependencies.

features.title: Neighborhood and path exploration
features.description:
Add GET /graph/neighborhood?uuid=...&depth=N&edge_types=...
  - Use Cypher to return the induced subgraph within N hops (2–3 is typical), optionally filtering edge types.
  - Useful for agents to understand localized contexts.

features.title: Scoring transparency
features.description:
Include Graphiti-provided scores in responses. Standardize response schemas for edges/nodes with score.
Add observability metrics for search latency and hit counts.

You can see the sample responses here:
https://help.getzep.com/v3/sdk-reference/graph/search

features.title: Tests
features.description: There needs to be adequate testing to prove that the new search is working correctly
